CMT5pro is the final version (after CMT5b) of CMT5 a.k.a. ''The Dreamweaver'' that was part of the CMT (Custom Map Tournament) maps. In this version we deleted a hallway to make it less mazy and we retextured the map so its is easier to learn: Yellow textures at YA area, Red textures at RA area and Blue textures at Quad area. Also some changes on arches/doors.
